bugs.bug: nvm_get_mirror validates the mirror URL with an awk character class limited to letters, digits and `./_-`, so valid mirror URLs with a port, userinfo, an IPv6 host or percent-encoding are rejected
bugs.example: nvm.sh: the mirror check `^https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]+$` omits ':', '@', '[', ']' and '%', so http://mirror.example.com:8080/ and similar valid URLs fail with 'may only contain a URL'
